facts.value: ASU Family offers resources, programs and opportunities to connect you and your Sun Devil with other families and the range of experiences available at ASU.

This video series offers parents and families the opportunity to hear from university experts, students and other family members about ways to support their student throughout their college experience.

ASU offers campus visit tours almost every day. It is recommended that you visit ASU as early in the college decision-making process as possible and consider visiting in the fall, winter or spring due to hot summers.

ASU prioritizes safety and offers secure residence halls staffed around the clock, a full-time university police force, safety escorts, emergency call boxes, an alert system for campus emergencies, and a safety smartphone app called LiveSafe.
To help your student pay for college, you can apply for a Parent PLUS Loan, which requires a good credit history.
If you are an active duty member or veteran of the U.S. military, your student could be eligible for tuition benefits under the Post-9/11 GI Bill®.
